name: Uwerx
fix_description: In _transfer, when to == uniswapPoolAddress, only add userTransferAmount (97%) to _balances[to] instead of the full amount. The current code adds the full amount to the pool balance but then emits events and burns as if only partial was transferred, creating a mismatch between actual balances and intended transfer amounts.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a very short, direct reserve-manipulation/tokenomics exploit with only a few steps: buy the token, transfer a large amount to the pair, call skim/sync, then swap back for profit. It requires limited protocol-specific reasoning, no real flash-loan mechanics in the PoC, and the exploit path is obvious from the pair interaction and fee-on-transfer token behavior.
